mapper.select: SELECT MARKET FROM MARKET_MASTER ORDER BY MARKET
SELECT u.USERID, u.USERNAME, a.MARKET FROM HDOC_USER_INFOR u INNER JOIN HDOC_MARKET_AUTH a ON u.USERID = a.USERID WHERE u.USERID = #{userid}
SELECT u.USERID, u.USERNAME, a.MARKET FROM HDOC_USER_INFOR u INNER JOIN HDOC_MARKET_AUTH a ON u.USERID = a.USERID WHERE u.USERID IN (SELECT USERID FROM HDOC_USER_INFOR WHERE USER = #{user})
SELECT u.USERID, u.USERNAME, a.MARKET FROM HDOC_USER_INFOR u LEFT JOIN HDOC_MARKET_AUTH a ON u.USERID = a.USERID WHERE u.RESPONSIBLE = 'Rule' AND a.MARKET = #{market}
SELECT u.USERID, u.USERNAME, a.MARKET FROM HDOC_USER_INFOR u LEFT JOIN HDOC_MARKET_AUTH a ON u.USERID = a.USERID WHERE u.RESPONSIBLE = 'Template' AND a.MARKET = #{market}
SELECT u.USERID, u.USERNAME, m.MARKET FROM MARKET_MASTER m INNER JOIN HDOC_USER_INFOR u ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN HDOC_MARKET_AUTH a ON u.USERID = a.USERID
